"""Near-bound stress cases for the finite compiler (timing)."""
import ctypes, sys, json, random, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

def big_job(rng, ntrain=10000, nqueries=64, napproved=256):
    # 4 slots x 2 fields, domains of size 4 -> universe 4^8 = 65536
    fields = [{'name': f'f{i}', 'type': ['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],
               'domain': [0,1,2,3]} for i in range(2)]
    K = 4
    cells = K*2
    P = 32
    preds = []
    allrefs = [[s, f['name']] for s in range(K) for f in fields]
    for p in range(P):
        kind = rng.choice(['cmp','cmp','any','all'])
        if kind == 'cmp':
            if p % 3 == 0:
                n = rng.randint(1, 4)
                refs = rng.sample(allrefs, n)
                left = {'sum': refs}
            elif p % 3 == 1:
                left = {'scale': rng.randint(0, 65535), 'ref': rng.choice(allrefs)}
            else:
                left = {'ref': rng.choice(allrefs)}
            op = rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge'])
            right = {'ref': rng.choice(allrefs)} if rng.random() < 0.5 else {'const': rng.randint(0,1000000), 'type': 'count'}
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':left,'op':op,'right':right})
        else:
            f = rng.choice(fields)
            preds.append({'kind':kind,'field':f['name'],'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']),
                          'value':rng.randint(0,1000000)})
    train = [[[rng.randrange(4) for _ in fields] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(ntrain)]
    approved = set()
    while len(approved) < napproved:
        sz = rng.randint(1, 4)
        cl = tuple(sorted(rng.sample(range(P), sz)))
        approved.add(cl)
    approved = [list(c) for c in sorted(approved)]
    queries = []
    for q in range(nqueries):
        fixed = []
        refs = list(allrefs); rng.shuffle(refs)
        k = rng.randint(0, 3)
        for ref in refs[:k]:
            fixed.append({'ref': ref, 'value': rng.randrange(4)})
        queries.append({'target': refs[k], 'prefix': rng.choice(['','0','1','2','3','12','03','1234567']),
                        'fixed': fixed})
    return {'fields': fields, 'slots': K, 'predicates': preds, 'width': 4,
            'train': train, 'approved': approved, 'queries': queries}

def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    jobs = [big_job(rng), big_job(rng, ntrain=5000, nqueries=32)]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    res = [compile_job(j) for j in jobs]
    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    blob = json.dumps({'results': res}, separators=(',', ':'))
    dtj = time.perf_counter() - t1
    nrules = [len(r['rules']) for r in res]
    print(f'stress seed={seed} compute={dt:.2f}s json={dtj:.2f}s rules={nrules} out={len(blob)/1e6:.1f}MB')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
PYEOF
